name: shared-helper-owner-search
goal: Keep helper calls searchable by both their callable names and owning module names.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: 0f7a9504 changed function row names to callable symbols and accidentally dropped owner titles from search. The existing 1000-row responsive console scenario reproduces it at all three viewports.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Focused catalog checks searched callable names only. Extend the shared collection identity matrix to require owner-title search when displayed names differ; the normal Reports unit suite enforces it.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 2e645a55 fails owner-title search in the collection identity matrix and all three existing 1000-row responsive console scenarios. Browser failure screenshots retained in /tmp/harness-helper-owner-before-tablet.png.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Keep callable names for display and ordering while including the owning entity name in search. The shared identity matrix and existing scale scenario guard aliases; document both as catalog acceptance requirements.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Search includes owner names alongside callable names and purposes. README makes alias preservation part of catalog acceptance; the normal unit suite enforces the shared identity matrix.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 84f4c759 passes the unchanged collection identity guard and all three 1000-row responsive console scenarios after failure at 2e645a55. Helper and owning module names both remain searchable.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated current-source snapshot: removing owner names from search makes the shared identity assertion fail; restoring the fix passes all 7 collection tests. Product checkout unchanged. Log: /tmp/harness-helper-owner-guard.log.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Reports workspace check passed: 596 tests, formatting, typecheck, lint, three builds and audit. All 30 related browser cases pass, with no unexpected browser diagnostics. Root formatting, typecheck, lint, kernel checks/build and 854 unit tests passed (25 live cases skipped). The full root check was interrupted during broader E2E after 13 passing cases, so full cross-platform verification remains pending; no native UI testing or main merge. Exact-commit history integration and immutable red/green pairs are recorded separately. Live preview 5688 verified helper search, schema exclusion and owner-history links. Cached projections were enriched from exact Git commits without changing prior records, media or other fields. Logs: /tmp/harness-helpers-reports-final-check.log, /tmp/harness-helpers-browser-final.log, /tmp/harness-helpers-root-check.log.
